c: Is an old, broken fence cluttering your property? What was once a beautiful boundary marker or privacy screen is not there, with leaning posts, broken panels, and sharp edges that pose safety risks. Over time, weather and wear can transform any fence into a hazardous liability that detracts from your property’s appeal.

Professional fence demolition requires specialized skills, proper equipment, and careful execution. Our expert team brings all three to every project. We’re equipped with professional-grade tools and techniques to efficiently remove your old fence without damaging your landscaping or property. One simple call is all it takes to turn that deteriorating fence line into a clean slate for your new project.

blocks.text: Tired of Looking at That Old, Unsafe Fence? Call Now or Book Online

c: That leaning fence in your yard isn’t fixing itself. What was once a crisp property boundary or privacy screen has become a broken collection of splintered wood, bent metal, and unstable posts. The panels are falling apart, the nails are rusting out, and every windstorm threatens to send another section crashing down.

We specialize in making problematic fences vanish quickly, safely, and affordably. Our professional fence demolition service starts at just {{cad_125}}, and we handle every step from removing the first post to final cleanup of your property line.

Ready to reclaim your space? Call us at +1 647 922 5865 or book online.

items: Our professional team specializes in fence demolition and removal for all property types, whether dealing with a simple backyard boundary or a complex commercial perimeter. From short residential picket fences to long privacy screens and commercial chain-link barriers, we handle every aspect of fence demolition projects with expert precision.

items.q: Do you remove all types of fences, including wood, metal, and vinyl?
a: Yes, we professionally remove all fence types, including wood (cedar, pressure-treated pine), metal (wrought iron, aluminum), vinyl (privacy, picket), and chain link fences in any condition.

items.q: How much does fence removal cost?
a: Our fence demolition services start at just $125, with final pricing based on the fence length, height, material type, and complexity of post/concrete removal.

items.q: What areas do you serve for fence demolition?
a: We serve all GTA areas including Toronto, Mississauga, Brampton, Vaughan, Markham, Richmond Hill, Oakville, Burlington, Oshawa, Pickering, Ajax, Whitby, Newmarket, Aurora, King City, Caledon, and surrounding communities.

items.q: Do I need a permit for deck removal?
a: Most municipalities don’t require permits for demolition, but we’ll advise on local regulations and can handle permits if needed.

items.q: Do you handle post and concrete base removal?
a: Absolutely. Our service includes complete removal of all fence posts and concrete footings – we leave no trace behind.
